# Documentation routes referenced by README.md.
#
# ONE list, TWO consumers, on purpose:
#   * tests/test_readme_guard.py pins that every docs.aetherfy.com link in the
#     README is one of these (offline, every CI run);
#   * .github/workflows/docs-links.yml fetches each one weekly and fails red on
#     any non-200 (network, scheduled only).
#
# The guard alone could never catch a docs-site RESTRUCTURE: it checks that a
# URL is in this list, not that the URL resolves. Add a route here only after
# confirming it loads — docs.aetherfy.com/api and vectors.aetherfy.com/docs
# were both invented, and both 404'd.
https://docs.aetherfy.com
https://docs.aetherfy.com/vectors
https://docs.aetherfy.com/vectors/api
https://docs.aetherfy.com/vectors/sdk
https://docs.aetherfy.com/vectors/filtering
https://docs.aetherfy.com/vectors/limits
https://docs.aetherfy.com/vectors/errors
https://docs.aetherfy.com/vectors/search-tuning
https://docs.aetherfy.com/quickstart
